texts: The Keepers count the visible sky-cats on the cliff-spires each morning.
The Keepers track the weight of the feather harvest.

fields.sentence: The Keepers count the visible sky-cats on the cliff-spires each morning.

review.notes: "The Keepers" follows the capitalized-plural-label rule exactly (Name-only individual, no GroupOf, no keeper typing), and "each morning" takes the named-slot Time term plus its implied Every cycle with no tense atom. "On the cliff-spires" is attached to the sky-cats rather than to the counting event - the favoured site, though the event attachment is also coherent.

fields.sentence: The Keepers track the weight of the feather harvest.

q1_issues.issue: The of-phrase in 'the weight of the feather harvest' is attached with the nominalization-object oblique (Of ...), but it fails that route's stated verb-paraphrase test ('the weight of the harvest' is not 'what weighs the harvest' — the harvest is weigh's subject, not its object), so the ordinary genitive Possession is what the rules assign.

q2_gaps: A dimension/attribute noun used referentially with no magnitude ('the weight of X'): the Measure family requires a stated number and unit, and the of-phrase taxonomy (partitive / measure / about-phrase / nominalization-object / genitive) has no explicit slot for an attribute noun whose of-NP is the underlying stative subject.
review.notes: 'The Keepers' correctly takes the capitalized-plural-label Name-only treatment (no GroupOf, no per-member kind); feather_harvest fusion plus genus, Theme for the recording verb 'track', and the unmarked habitual present are all right.

issues.reason: The instruction set assigns no Possession here: the true-relational-noun genitive branch is expressly gated on 'where no underlying verb exists' (weight/weigh fails that gate) and the *Complements of nouns and adjectives* section opens with 'never Possession for an argument', so the entity-attached surface-preposition oblique (Of sk_weight_1 sk_harvest_1) — the very head that section exemplifies — is a true, well-typed record of the words in territory the reviewer itself files as a gap.

gaps_confirmed: An attribute / dimension noun used referentially with no magnitude ('the weight of X') fits no branch of the of-phrase taxonomy, and the Measure family cannot carry it because it requires a stated magnitude and unit.
new_gaps: Neither of-phrase branch fires when the of-NP is the head noun's underlying SUBJECT: the nominalization-object route's verb-paraphrase test ('the N of X' = 'what Vs X') fails, while the relational-noun genitive route is gated on no underlying verb existing. A licensed form would need to name the BEARER of an attribute noun (the entity the dimension is predicated of), which is neither an object nor a possessor.
adjudication.notes: Everything else holds: 'the Keepers' takes the capitalized-plural-label Name-only treatment (no GroupOf, no invented per-member kind), feather_harvest carries its head genus with the noun modifier unexposed, track takes Theme as a recording verb, and the simple present correctly stays unmarked.
